summary: Possibly John's 3rd cousin 8x removed (Bull → Jonathan → Deborah → Joseph → Joseph); SAR patriot buried at Hauppauge.
bio: Elder Joseph Blydenburgh, son of a Dutch New Yorker, married Deborah daughter of Jonathan Smith on 8 Jul 1692 (she d. before May 1699), then Catherine DeHart; founded the Blydenburgh homestead at the Branch. This younger Joseph moved to Hauppauge and survived a British search of his house for gold hidden in a churn. SAR-recognized patriot buried in Hauppauge Rural Cemetery.
